zh.title: 台鐵南迴線枋山至枋野段搶通 8月26日首班車恢復正常營運
zh.summary: 台鐵南迴線枋山至枋野區間已完成搶通；列車自8月26日首班車起全面恢復正常行駛。
body: 根據官方營運訊息，台鐵南迴線位於枋山至枋野之間的路段現已順利完成搶通作業。在相關路線經過搶修並確認安全後，該鐵路區間已具備恢復車輛正常通行的條件。
隨著該區間路線搶通，台鐵宣布南迴線自8月26日首班車起全面恢復正常行駛。全線各班次列車將按照原定營運計畫發車，提供正常軌道運輸服務。
枋山至枋野路段搶通作業完成後，台鐵南迴線整體列車調度與班次服務重新恢復銜接。各班次列車將按照既定時刻表正常行駛，維護該鐵路路線的穩定營運與整體運輸順暢。

en.title: Taiwan Railways Clears South Link Line Section for Normal Service Resumption on August 26
en.summary: Taiwan Railways clears South Link Line between Fangshan and Fangye, resuming normal service on August 26.
body: Taiwan Railways announced that the section of the South Link Line between Fangshan and Fangye has been cleared. Repair crews completed necessary operations, allowing rail traffic to safely pass through the affected corridor once again.

With the track reopening, Taiwan Railways confirmed that normal train operations on the South Link Line will resume starting from the first scheduled train on August 26. All scheduled rail services will run according to regular timetables.
The restoration of service between Fangshan and Fangye reconnects rail transit along the line, ensuring stable operations and consistent schedule reliability across the local railway network.
